parole.significato: a thing (concrete or abstract – also of events, like in English)
parole.testo: From earlier greja (whence the alternative plural form grejor). Borrowed from Norwegian greie, (dialectal) greida (“arrangement, (pl.) tools”). Derived from Old Norse greiða (“to arrange, comb, pay, perform”). Cognate with Danish grej, Norwegian Bokmål greie, and Norwegian Nynorsk greie.
From Norwegian syl, from Old Norse súl, from Proto-Germanic *sūliz (“post, beam”).
